meeting.title: BrightSmile x Northbeam - Project kickoff call

summary: BrightSmile confirmed the Recommended option (SMS reminders in, Zalo and the dashboard after Tet) and agreed the booking and handover rules for the assistant. This week's critical path is access and content: SMS account details and Facebook admin by Friday 4 Dec, calendar sharing on Monday 7 Dec, and the price and insurer lists on 3 Dec so the Vietnamese script can go to review by 11 Dec and be approved before the 18 Dec content freeze. Still open: who receives handover alerts at night at each clinic.

decisions.decision: Go with the Recommended option; the admin dashboard is postponed until after Tet.
decisions.rationale: Director's call to keep scope focused on the pre-Tet launch.
decisions.source_quote: We're going with the Recommended option. The dashboard can wait until after Tet.

decisions.decision: Day-before SMS reminders are in scope; Zalo is out for now.
decisions.source_quote: Then SMS reminders are in, Zalo is out for now.

decisions.decision: Only check-ups, cleaning, fillings and whitening can be booked online; every other treatment becomes a consultation request. The last appointment must end 30 minutes before closing.
decisions.rationale: Implants and root canals need a consultation first; dentists want to avoid overtime.
decisions.source_quote: only check-ups, cleaning, fillings and whitening are bookable online; everything else goes to a consultation request. And the last appointment ends 30 minutes before closing.

decisions.decision: Urgent symptoms (pain, swelling, bleeding) get the clinic hotline immediately plus a handover alert; other medical questions and complaints get a normal handover.
decisions.rationale: Patients in pain should not wait for a front-desk reply.
decisions.source_quote: urgent symptoms get the hotline number straight away plus a handover alert. Everything else that's medical gets a normal handover.

decisions.decision: The assistant never confirms insurance coverage; it says coverage depends on the plan and offers a front-desk check.
decisions.rationale: Coverage for insurers such as Cigna or Bupa depends on the individual plan.
decisions.source_quote: the bot will say coverage depends on the plan and offer to have the front desk check

decisions.decision: Both Hoa Tran and Dr. Minh Le review the script, and approval is given within 2 business days.
decisions.source_quote: We need approval within two business days to keep the content freeze on the 18th.

decisions.decision: User testing runs on 28, 29 and 30 December with Thu Nguyen and Khoa Pham.

action_items.title: Check SMS brandname on TinNhanNhanh account and send details
action_items.description: Confirm whether the sender name "BrightSmile" is registered on the existing TinNhanNhanh account and send the account details to Northbeam. High priority: sender name registration has the longest lead time in the plan.
action_items.source_quote: I'll check with the provider and send you the account details by Friday.

action_items.title: Send service account email for calendar sharing
action_items.description: Send Hoa the Google service account address the 11 dentist calendars should be shared with. Blocks A3.
action_items.source_quote: I'll send the email address after this call.

action_items.title: Share all 11 dentist calendars with the service account
action_items.description: Needs the IT admin, who is back on Monday. High priority: calendar booking is built in week 3.
action_items.source_quote: I can do the sharing, but only on Monday

action_items.title: Send latest price list and insurer list to An
action_items.description: The price list changed in November; Thu has the current version. High priority: the Vietnamese script depends on it.
action_items.source_quote: I'll send the price list and the insurer list to An tomorrow.

action_items.title: Draft Vietnamese script and send to Hoa and Dr. Minh for review
action_items.description: First Vietnamese conversation script built from the price and insurer lists, following decisions D3-D5. Send to both reviewers (D6). High priority: the content freeze is 18 Dec.
action_items.source_quote: I'll turn that into the first Vietnamese script and send it for review by end of next week.

action_items.title: Review and approve the Vietnamese script
action_items.description: Dr. Minh Le and Hoa Tran review within 2 business days of receiving the draft. Due date inferred from A5 being sent on Fri 11 Dec. High priority: protects the 18 Dec content freeze.

action_items.title: Add insurance-coverage test case to the test script
action_items.description: The assistant must never answer "yes" outright when asked whether an insurer (e.g. Cigna, Bupa) is covered (D5).
action_items.source_quote: Yes, I'll add it to the test script.

action_items.title: Ask marketing agency to add Bao as Facebook page admin
action_items.description: Admin access is needed to connect Messenger. Hoa said "hopefully" by Friday - follow up if it slips. High priority: blocks the Messenger connection.
action_items.source_quote: I'll ask them to add Bao as admin, hopefully by Friday.

action_items.title: Send testing invites for 28-30 Dec to Thu and Khoa
action_items.description: Calendar invites for the three user-testing days (D7).

action_items.title: Add optional "how did you hear about us" question to booking
action_items.description: One optional question at the end of a new-patient booking, requested for marketing. Included in the script draft, so the due date is inferred from A5.
action_items.source_quote: It's small, I'll include it in the script draft.
